Specification: This module defines a small mathematical specification involving sequences and partial functions over a singleton set. It constructs the set S = {"s"}, defines R as Seq(S), defines a partial-function constructor Part_Funct(D, R), and introduces a constant C together with an assumption about DOMAIN C to force evaluation involving Seq(S). The module also defines a concrete function-valued expression C2 over the domain [S -> R] and {Part_Funct(S, R)} mapping every pair to TRUE; the file includes a TLC configuration module that overrides C with C2, but no state-transition system, actions, temporal behavior, fairness, or proofs are present.
